```{r}
# Set the directory path to your TSV files
file_paths <- list.files("./", pattern = "\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Read and combine all files, skipping lines that start with '##'
all_data <- file_paths %>%
  map_dfr(~ read_tsv(.x, comment = "##"))

all_data

all_data %>%
  filter(Protein != "-") %>%
  filter(Effect != "silent") %>%
    filter(Effect != "3prime_UTR_variant") %>%
  select(Gene, Effect, Protein, A427_Par_Control_VAF, A427_Par_RMC_Clone_2_VAF, A427_Par_RMC_Clone_3_VAF, A427_Par_ACBI3_Clone_1_VAF, A427_Par_ACBI3_Clone_2_VAF, A427_Par_MRTX_Clone_1_VAF, A427_Par_MRTX_Clone_3_VAF, A427_Par_RMC_Clone_2_VAF, A427_Par_RMC_Clone_3_VAF) %>%
  distinct()

all_data %>%
    filter(Effect != "intronic") %>%
  filter(Gene != "-") %>%
    filter(Effect != "silent") %>%
  filter(Effect != "downstream") %>%
    filter(Effect != "upstream") %>%
  filter(Filter == "PASS") %>%
  select(Gene, Effect, Protein, Type, A427_Par_Control_VAF, A427_Par_RMC_Clone_2_VAF, A427_Par_RMC_Clone_3_VAF, A427_Par_ACBI3_Clone_1_VAF, A427_Par_ACBI3_Clone_2_VAF, A427_Par_MRTX_Clone_1_VAF, A427_Par_MRTX_Clone_3_VAF, A427_Par_RMC_Clone_2_VAF, A427_Par_RMC_Clone_3_VAF, A427_Par_BI_Clone_1_VAF, A427_Par_BI_Clone_3_VAF) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  write.csv("summary.csv")

all_data %>%
  filter(Gene == "NF1") %>%
  select(Gene, A427_Par_Control_VAF, A427_Par_RMC_Clone_2_VAF, A427_Par_RMC_Clone_3_VAF, A427_Par_ACBI3_Clone_1_VAF, A427_Par_ACBI3_Clone_2_VAF, A427_Par_MRTX_Clone_1_VAF, A427_Par_MRTX_Clone_3_VAF, A427_Par_RMC_Clone_2_VAF, A427_Par_RMC_Clone_3_VAF, A427_Par_BI_Clone_1_VAF, A427_Par_BI_Clone_3_VAF) %>%
  distinct()

all_data %>%
  filter(Gene == "CDK13") %>%
  select(Gene, Effect, Protein, A427_Par_Control_VAF, A427_Par_RMC_Clone_2_VAF, A427_Par_RMC_Clone_3_VAF, A427_Par_ACBI3_Clone_1_VAF, A427_Par_ACBI3_Clone_2_VAF, A427_Par_MRTX_Clone_1_VAF, A427_Par_MRTX_Clone_3_VAF, A427_Par_RMC_Clone_2_VAF, A427_Par_RMC_Clone_3_VAF, A427_Par_BI_Clone_1_VAF, A427_Par_BI_Clone_3_VAF) %>%
  distinct()

all_data %>%
  filter(Gene == "CDK13") %>%
  distinct()
```

```{r}
# check variants in RMC clone 3
all_data %>%
  colnames()

#all variants in RM clone 3 with VAF of 0.1 and over 10 reads and no mutant reads in control sample - 3898
all_data %>%
  select(Gene, Protein, Ref, RNA, Transcript, Type, Effect, Alt, VariantID, Chrom, Pos, CDS, Filter, contains(c("Par_Control", "RMC_Clone_3"))) %>%
  filter(A427_Par_Control_DEP >10) %>%
  filter(A427_Par_RMC_Clone_3_DEP >10) %>%
  filter(A427_Par_Control_MTR == 0) %>%
  filter(A427_Par_RMC_Clone_3_VAF > 0.1) %>%
  distinct()

#protein changes subset - 75
all_data %>%
  select(Gene, Protein, Ref, RNA, Transcript, Type, Effect, Alt, VariantID, Chrom, Pos, CDS, Filter, contains(c("Par_Control", "RMC_Clone_3"))) %>%
  filter(A427_Par_Control_DEP >10) %>%
  filter(A427_Par_RMC_Clone_3_DEP >10) %>%
  filter(A427_Par_Control_MTR == 0) %>%
  filter(A427_Par_RMC_Clone_3_VAF > 0.1) %>%
  filter(Protein != "-") %>%
  filter(Protein != "p.?") %>%
    filter(Effect != "silent") %>%
  distinct()

all_data %>%
  select(Gene, Protein, Ref, RNA, Transcript, Type, Effect, Alt, VariantID, Chrom, Pos, CDS, Filter, contains(c("Par_Control", "RMC_Clone_2"))) %>%
```
